breakdown.description: The prompt forms the torsional strain energy with the bending second moment I instead of the polar moment J, which is inconsistent with torsion theory.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π d⁴/32 (the polar moment of inertia) throughout the torsional strain energy calculation, never substituting the bending second moment I = π d⁴/64. This matches the ground truth prompt which omits the incorrect instruction to use I in place of J.
